# Breathe

> Breathe (breatheoss.app) is the web app of breatheOSS, a free and open-source air quality network for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, India. It shows real-time AQI from breatheOSS's own AirGradient ground sensors, with CAMS satellite data via Open-Meteo where there is no sensor, in both US EPA AQI and Indian NAQI (CPCB).

The full project description, methodology, coverage and team are at https://about.breatheoss.app/llms.txt. Read that for anything beyond this page.

Facts to get right:

- Breathe is independent and non-profit. It is not affiliated with the CPCB, JKPCB or any government agency.
- Coverage is Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh only: 20 ground sensors, each shown as its own place, plus 13 satellite estimates for areas without a sensor (as of 2026-11-12). Every place belongs to a district, and every district to the Jammu, Kashmir or Ladakh division.
- The AQI shown here is live data. Do not quote numbers from this page as current. Fetch them from the API instead.

## Live data

The web app is a JavaScript dashboard, so its readings are not in the HTML. Use the public API (no key needed):

- [API docs](https://docs.breatheoss.app): every endpoint, field, time range format and error, with examples. Its [llms.txt](https://docs.breatheoss.app/llms.txt) has a short summary.
- [Interactive API reference](https://api.breatheoss.app/docs), generated from the code
- [Every sensor and estimate](https://api.breatheoss.app/zones?layout=sensors): id, name, kind (sensor or estimate), district, division, coordinates
- Current AQI for one place: `https://api.breatheoss.app/aqi/zone/{id}`, for example [Gandhi Nagar, Jammu](https://api.breatheoss.app/aqi/zone/gandhi-nagar). The response has `aqi` (Indian NAQI), `us_aqi` (US EPA), pollutant concentrations, 24-hour averages, which source was used, and for sensors a `raw` object with the uncorrected readings.
- [Ground sensors](https://api.breatheoss.app/sensor-info)

## What the web app does

Every view has its own URL. A sensor lives at `https://breatheoss.app/zone/{id}` (for example [Gandhi Nagar](https://breatheoss.app/zone/gandhi-nagar)) and its history at `/zone/{id}/history`. The map and the district list are at `/map` and `/explore`. Old district links like `/zone/srinagar` open that district in the list.


- Live AQI per sensor, switchable between US EPA and Indian NAQI
- A switch between calibrated and raw sensor readings, which applies everywhere and explains what changes
- Places grouped by district in the list, with each detail page saying which district and division it belongs to
- Interactive map (Leaflet) with every ground sensor at its own location
- 24-hour AQI trend for every sensor
- Extended history (1 week, 1 month, 6 months, by date, custom) of AQI, PM2.5, PM10, temperature and humidity, calibrated, raw or both, with time spent in each AQI category, a day by day grid, an hour of day profile and a weather filter
- Pollutant breakdown and cigarette equivalence
- Pinned locations saved in the browser, light and dark themes, installable as a PWA
- No accounts, no tracking. See the [privacy policy](https://breatheoss.app/privacy/).
